definitions.explanation: An official who enforces the rules and makes calls in a game, especially baseball and tennis.

アンパイア⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抗議|こうぎ}する→抗議する：26923_kougisuru⟧。

⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アンパイア⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: After the game, the manager told reporters he was unhappy with the umpire's calls.

notes:
From English "umpire", used mainly in baseball. Everyday baseball talk and broadcasts often use ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧ instead.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧: referee, umpire; the general word for any sport.
- ⟦レフェリー→レフェリー：31430_referii⟧: referee; used in soccer, boxing, and rugby.
